scope: For every affinely independent Fin(d+2) score family in Gaussian Space(d+1), the canonical equal-mass winning cluster has squared intrinsic total inner perimeter at least (d+1)*simplexConstant(d+2)^2/2.
normalization: Total perimeter = one half the sum of each cell perimeter. Each cell functional is minus the right derivative of its actual closed-ball erosion mass at zero.
proved_bridge: Every actual full simplicial cell has an erosion derivative equal to the constructed Gaussian density facet-flux sum.
independent_thought_notes: The full score-price fan has a unique common apex and is a translation of the zero-price conical fan; this is proved in GaussianSimplicialApex.lean.
An elementary derivation from individual one-cell Gaussian isoperimetry is too weak to give the required all-k constant.

Minimizing over affine fans alone does not automatically imply stationarity under arbitrary local variations; a finite-family minimum argument must establish the required variation directions rather than assume them.
Triple-junction force balance would enforce equidistance by affine independence, but deriving that balance at a relevant minimizer remains an unproved geometric step.
halfspace_bridge_scope: All unit-normal halfspaces in arbitrary positive ambient dimension, at every offset; compiled development proofs, independent audit deferred.
conventional_BV_bridge_scope: Unconditional actual_simplicial_cell_BV_upper for every affinely independent full simplicial score family, every price and every cell; this is the needed BV <= erosion direction, not an exact-equality assertion.
